# Step 1: login to amazon and list last orders

# Get amazon password from supervisor
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
amazon_pw = None
for item in pw_list:
    if item.get('account_name')=='amazon':
        amazon_pw = item.get('password')
print('amazon_pw_present', bool(amazon_pw))

username = 'normansmit@gmail.com'
login_res = apis.amazon.login(username=username, password=amazon_pw)
print('login_res', login_res)

amazon_token = login_res.get('access_token')
print('token_present', bool(amazon_token))

orders_all = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.amazon.show_orders(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
    # page expected list
    if not page:
        break
    orders_all.extend(page)
    print('page', page_index, 'num_orders', len(page))
    page_index += 1

print('total_orders', len(orders_all))
# show top 3 order ids with created_at for debugging
print('top_orders', [(o['order_id'], o.get('created_at')) for o in orders_all[:3]])
